title: Horn of Africa Drought Tracker Update — Nov 22, 2026
summary: Searches found no newly dated developments since the 18 Nov update, and no event with two independent sources could be verified for 15–22 Nov. Existing figures (Somalia 5.4M in IPC Phase 3+ for Oct–Dec; regional need of 20–25.9M) are unchanged. Only the last-updated timestamp changed.

title: Horn of Africa Drought Tracker Update — Nov 15, 2026
summary: Added reporting on the 23 Sep IPC Somalia analysis: about 26,000 displaced people in Baidoa are projected in IPC Phase 5 for Oct–Dec, alongside a conditional (not confirmed) Risk of Famine under a severe-flood scenario. Somalia-wide projections stay at 5.4M in Phase 3+. The October IPC follow-up result was not found, and no other major new developments were verified.

title: Horn of Africa Drought Tracker Update — Oct 18, 2026
summary: FEWS NET's 6 Oct special report warns that El Niño and a positive Indian Ocean Dipole may bring flood-scale rainfall to areas weakened by consecutive droughts. It flags a risk of Famine (IPC 5) in southern Somalia under a 1997/98-scale flood, though not the most likely scenario. Somalia needs peak Oct–Dec, Kenya Oct–Nov, and southern Ethiopia Jan–Mar 2027.
